summary: Iteration 2 fixes/features fully verified on FitStudio AI. Backend: 13/13 new pytest tests passed (PATCH /auth/profile incl. duplicate-email rejection + email change + super-admin variant, POST /auth/password wrong→400 / correct→200 with re-login, GET /admin/studios/<uuid> for SUPER_ADMIN with members+classes+exercises payload + 403 for owner + 404 for bad uuid, admin/metrics.total_exercises present, classes PATCH title+music_style with persistence, classes DELETE→204 + 404 after, studios PATCH avatar_preference+voice_preference). Frontend: super admin lands on /app/admin showing 6 KPI cards (Studios/Users/Classes/Rendered/In progress/Exercises) and clickable studio rows that navigate to /app/admin/studios/<id> with Members + Classes + Studio exercises sections. Super-admin sidebar correctly shows Super Admin + Exercise Library + My profile only (no Branding/Avatar/Classes). Owner dashboard shows 4 KPI cards as Link components (13 outbound links to /app/classes & /app/exercises). Classes list shows All/In progress/Ready tabs; clicking Ready updates URL to ?tab=ready; Delete buttons open AlertDialog with confirmation. Branding page: changing color via picker pushes --primary CSS var live (153 32% 17% → 20 100% 30%). Avatar Studio: 3 template cards + Voice select + Render sample produces preview video (MOCKED ~2s) + Save defaults. Exercise library: 'Why a library?' explainer visible at top. Profile page (both roles) renders personal-details + change-password forms; wrong-current-password attempt surfaces toast 'Current password is incorrect' (verified for owner — seed creds not changed).
critical_code_review_comments: accounts/views.me PATCH does not validate first_name/last_name length/format — could store extreme strings. Low priority.
accounts/views.change_password enforces only len(new_pw)>=6; consider stronger validation (digit + symbol) for prod.
admin_studio_detail returns full FitnessClassListSerializer + ExerciseSerializer + UserSerializer for an entire studio without pagination — could grow heavy; fine for current scale.
Branding live-apply uses inline hex→HSL conversion in /lib/theme.js; ensure handler also gracefully ignores invalid 3-letter or non-hex strings (manual hex input could send '#zzz').
Avatar Studio Render sample is MOCKED with a static placeholder mp4 URL; documented in MOCKED list.
Classes PATCH endpoint accepts is_approved/script_json without role gating (any studio member can flip approval) — same as iteration 1 note, still acceptable for POC.

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 iteration-2 tests; previous 24/24 still green per iteration 1)
